messages:
Samir: quick heads-up — noticed a small snippet in /docs/runtime/quickstart.md that throws a linter error in CI. link: https://internal.docs/redwood/runtime/quickstart#example

It looks like the code fence is missing the language tag and one of the backticks is doubled, so the markdown parser chokes. Error from CI: `markdownlint: MD013/MD047` in the generated html build.

Jules: @Samir can you paste the exact snippet? I can push a one-line fix if it's just the fence.

Samir: sure — here's the block from the page:
```
```python
def start_inference(payload):
    # sample
    return run_model(payload)
````

(the extra backtick at the end is the culprit)

Katy: :eyes: I think this was added in #4321 (runtime quickstart rewrite). I can open a tiny PR to replace the triple backticks and add `python` tag. Do we want to also add a short test to the docs CI to catch this going forward?

Maria (docs): thanks for catching. quick patch is fine — please include a brief note in the PR description mentioning the lint rule so the reviewer knows why. small ask: add a one-line mention in the edit that the snippet is intentionally minimal (keeps examples consistent).

Jules: I'll queue it now. tagging @katy for review since she led the rewrite. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5892 — includes the fence fix and a one-liner test that runs `markdownlint .` as part of the docs preview job.

Katy: reviewing rn. if green I'll merge and backfill a changelog entry in `docs/CHANGELOG.md` under "minor fixes".

deploy-bot: docs-preview build started for PR 5892 — status: pending

Samir: appreciate the quick turnaround. if merged, can someone mark the runtime quickstart as reviewed in the docs board? want to avoid repeated small fixes on the same page. :thumbsup:

Maria (docs): will do. adding a follow-up task: "QA: runtime quickstart snippet coverage" with a reminder to add that lint check to the docs checklist.

Katy: merged and deployed to staging. CI shows docs-preview ✅. small changelog note added.

Jules: thanks all — closing this thread but leaving the card in the docs board so we can track adding the lint check permanently. :shipit:
